question: On one fresh common-random-number Duskblade rectangle, does selecting the existing Beacon Art instead of authored-default Flare create an identity-safe, mediator-expressed, policy-selective and functionally separate Shatter package without broad win, duration, reliability, Scoreline or Afterimage movement?

scientificBasis.mechanism: Flare and Beacon are two already-authored live Art choices. Flare spends three Embers for nine damage to every living enemy. Beacon spends two Embers for one turn-scoped self Beacon stack; exact direct controls prove that an unblocked Dusk Attack then receives one additional implicit Facet chip while blocked Dusk and all Ash attacks receive none.
scientificBasis.policyQuestion: A strategy package requires policies that reproducibly convert Beacon into observed Attack chip events and positive Shatter movement, plus policies with exact zero Shatter movement. Automatic Art use alone is not a package witness.
scientificBasis.causalQuestion: Within each policy-seed identity, explicit Flare and Beacon are the only varying levels. The primary estimand is the policy-cluster mean paired difference in total whole-run Shatters.
scientificBasis.staging: A trace-only null sentinel runs first. Capacity rows run only if the added Art and Beacon mediator observation preserves omitted-versus-explicit-Flare complete identity. Every causal endpoint is then evaluated on the same complete two-arm rectangle.
scientificBasis.methodBoundary: No candidate generator, content edit, new Art, ML, RL, optimiser, adaptive cell, protected seed or human label enters this block.

lanternArt.type: binary live-product causal factor encoded only in the research runner
lanternArt.candidate: The existing selectable Beacon Art with unchanged cost and effect.
lanternArt.onlyWrite: After exact RunState.new_run construction, set run.art to the registered content Art ID without reading or advancing RNG.

scorelinePayoff.status: Separate fixed factor. It is not varied, bundled or estimated.

afterimagePayoff.status: Separate fixed factor. It is not varied, bundled or estimated.

design.type: one binary mechanism block with common random numbers and a fail-fast trace-null sentinel
design.blocking: Every Art contrast uses the same frozen policy identity, simulation seed, Duskblade aspect, Vow 5, content, policy, estimator and stopping rule.
design.noCartesianExpansion: Scoreline and Afterimage payoffs remain absent and fixed. Their observed package activations are separate shared interference anchors, not factorial levels. No additional joint cell is authorised merely to complete a product.

traceIdentity.question: Do the new Art-use, Beacon-Attack and Beacon-chip trace arrays preserve the complete omitted-versus-explicit-Flare row and remain empty of false Beacon events?
traceIdentity.gate: All complete rows must be pairwise exact after removing only id and arm. Both Beacon arrays must be empty, every observed Art ID must be Flare and the frozen eight-field trace schema must be exact.
traceIdentity.failure: Stop before every Beacon row and close the Art family without trace repair or a second sentinel.

mediatorTrace.arts: For every ART queue event: fight, event, turn and authored Art ID.
mediatorTrace.beaconAttacks: For every played Attack while the reconstructed current-turn player Beacon stack is positive: fight, event, turn, card ID and Beacon stack.
mediatorTrace.beaconChips: For every Attack-derived CHIP queue event while that Beacon stack is positive: fight, event, turn, card ID, total chip event amount and Beacon stack.
mediatorTrace.reconstruction: TURN resets the reconstructed stack, the exact player Beacon STATUS event adds it and END_TURN clears it. Exact source has no other Beacon producer. The prior direct gate identifies the additional-chip mapping; this trace records realised mediator opportunity and events without decomposing a whole-run chip event post hoc.
mediatorTrace.claimBoundary: Beacon-chip events demonstrate mediator expression, not the isolated numeric contribution of the Beacon stack. The causal factor remains the complete authored Beacon-versus-Flare Art choice.

cohort.freshness: A read-only pre-freeze search found zero exact policyRoot 421901 and simulation seeds 421910 through 421913 in the append-only ledger and existing protocols or summaries.
cohort.baseline: Exact current-main content and policy at source c4130163c7fb8edd865c0adc95732aae03e1bad2.

definitions.mediatorActivePolicy: At least two of four Beacon rows contain one or more registered Beacon-chip events.
definitions.mediatorInactivePolicy: None of the four Beacon rows contains a registered Beacon-chip event.
definitions.positivePolicy: At least two of four paired Beacon-minus-Flare total-Shatter differences are positive and the policy mean difference is positive.
definitions.exactInactivePolicy: All four paired Beacon-minus-Flare total-Shatter differences equal zero exactly.
definitions.viablePolicy: A positive policy has at least one winning Beacon row that also contains a Beacon-chip event.
definitions.faultRow: Outcome is stall or error, or error is non-empty.
definitions.duration: Arithmetic mean combat turns across every fight in one whole run.

scoreline.definition: A robust policy plays Chisel before a later Faultline in one fight in at least two of four rows.
scoreline.status: Separate activation and interference anchor; Scoreline payoff is absent and not estimated.

afterimage.definition: A robust policy plays Ward before a later Warden's Edge in one fight in at least two of four rows.
afterimage.status: Separate activation and interference anchor; Afterimage payoff is absent and not estimated.

interactionsAndAliases.artPackage: Beacon versus Flare changes authored Ember cost and effect together. The experiment estimates that complete live choice and does not call its whole-run effect a pure one-chip payoff.
interactionsAndAliases.damageOpportunity: Replacing Flare damage can lengthen a combat and thereby create extra Shatter opportunity. Direct controls and realised Beacon-chip events establish the intended mediator, but the complete treatment effect retains this authored interaction.
interactionsAndAliases.scorelineInterference: Scoreline baseline-versus-Beacon robust activation flips are measured on the same cells. Eight or more flipped policies is preregistered decision-relevant interference and prevents candidate freezing.
interactionsAndAliases.afterimageInterference: Afterimage baseline-versus-Beacon robust activation flips are measured separately on the same cells. Eight or more flipped policies is preregistered decision-relevant interference and prevents candidate freezing.
interactionsAndAliases.noJointCells: No Scoreline or Afterimage payoff exists in exact current-main. This block therefore spends no speculative joint cell; material observed interference makes the result inconclusive rather than reviving a closed scalar family.

estimands.unit: Policy identity. Four CRN seed differences are averaged within policy before inference.
estimands.primary: Policy-cluster mean paired Beacon-minus-Flare difference in total whole-run Shatters.
estimands.duration: Policy-cluster mean paired difference in mean combat turns per fight.
estimands.globalMovement: Policy-cluster mean paired difference in whole-run win indicator.
estimands.policySensitivity: Exact positive, exact-inactive, ambiguous, mediator-active, mediator-inactive and viable policy counts.
estimands.functionalSeparation: Positive-policy candidate-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard counts against Scoreline and Afterimage separately.
estimands.interference: Exact robust activation-set flips between Flare and Beacon for Scoreline and Afterimage separately.
estimands.reliability: Baseline, Beacon and added fault identities.
estimands.notEstimated: No RandomBuild, detector, held-out, optimisation retention, product promotion, protected-seed, Scoreline payoff, Afterimage payoff or cross-payoff causal effect is estimated.

estimator.point: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the 64 within-policy mean CRN differences.
estimator.interval: Percentile bootstrap over the frozen 64 policy-cluster values.
estimator.stopping: One fixed complete first look after the trace-null sentinel; no sequential peeking, row extension, cohort replacement or threshold retune.

gates.provenance: The 16-policy support and inactivity minima, eight-policy viability and separate-anchor minima, 0.55 overlap ceiling and one-baseline-fault ceiling reuse the frozen 64-policy capacity scale. Eight anchor flips reaches the existing minimum decision-value count. The 0.25-turn, 0.10 global movement and 0.90 Vow-5 ceilings are unchanged guardrails.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python constructs both plans, runs the exact qualified binary, validates every trace and CRN identity, caches content-addressed plans and outputs, computes the frozen policy sets and bootstrap intervals and owns stop/go.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: Run the 16-row trace sentinel once. Only if exact, execute the full 512-row two-arm rectangle once and inspect all preregistered endpoints together.
executionAndStopping.successStop: Freeze Beacon only when every trace, mediator, support, inactivity, viability, separation, interference, causal effect, duration, global movement, Vow-5 and reliability gate passes.
executionAndStopping.futilityStop: Close the Art family when any fixed support, inactivity, viability, separation, interference, reliability, Vow-5 or trace gate fails; the Shatter upper interval is non-positive; duration is decisively above 0.25; or point global win movement exceeds 0.10.
executionAndStopping.inconclusiveStop: Stop at decision boundary 3 when no fixed failure exists but the Shatter, duration or global-movement interval straddles its boundary, or an operational wall-time or ledger condition prevents a decision.

decisionRules.success: All registered gates pass exactly at the one complete first look.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only the existing Beacon Art selection for one independently preregistered held-out confirmation on fresh policies and seeds. Held-out must reproduce complementarity, activation, functional separation, reachability, policy sensitivity, duration, zero added faults and separate anchor interference, and add required RandomBuild/global-power and gated-vow guardrails. Do not evaluate another Art, tune Beacon, promote product content, add ML/RL or spend protected seeds.
decisionRules.futility: A fixed gate fails or a causal/guardrail result is decisively on the wrong side of its boundary.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close the complete existing Lantern-Art family without another Art, trace repair, threshold change, cohort extension, policy selector, product mutation or rerun. Continue issue #421 with the next source- and evidence-backed structural Duskblade mechanism.
decisionRules.inconclusive: No fixed gate fails, but an interval or operational condition remains unresolved at the frozen cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the Lantern-Art block inconclusive at its preregistered cap. Do not extend rows, add a joint cell, vary another Art, change an anchor or infer a package claim.
decisionRules.noRetry: This is the single authorised capacity attempt. Do not edit the trace, cohort, gates, expected schema, source, protocol or runner after execution to obtain a different result.
